name: Electroline
author: Christian Palladini
description: Electroline (Hisense) air conditioners in the Omarchy bar: power, setpoint, mode and fan speed for every unit on the ConnectLife account, through Hisense's cloud.

barWidget.description: Drive the air conditioners from the bar: on and off, temperature, mode and fan. The units answer nothing on the LAN, so every command goes through the ConnectLife cloud.

schema.label: Refresh interval while the panel is closed (seconds)
schema.description: Hisense can lock an account that polls too hard, so this stays slow. Nobody is reading the bar closely anyway.

schema.label: Refresh interval while the panel is open (seconds)
schema.description: Faster, because a command takes a few seconds to come back from the cloud and the panel has to show when it has.

schema.label: Most cloud calls per minute
schema.description: A hard ceiling on everything this widget sends, polls included. Calls over the budget wait rather than being dropped. Hisense can lock an account that calls too often.

schema.label: Python interpreter
schema.description: Leave empty to use the virtualenv that scripts/setup-electroline creates in ~/.local/share/omarchy-electroline.

schema.label: Hide the icon while every unit is off
